ui_locale.description: The UI language locale (e.g., en-US, de, fr)

release_channel.description: The update channel: release, esr, beta, or daily

hide_plugins_infobar.description: Whether to hide the missing plugin info bar

disable_plugins.description: If true, sets the preference to totally disable loading plugins (MOZILLA_DISABLE_PLUGINS equivalent)

safe_mode.description: If true, disables crash recovery to mimic safe-mode startup behavior regarding extensions state persistence

no_remote.description: If true, configures preferences to prevent connecting to a running instance
